verses.he: אֵל־נְקָמ֥וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֵ֖ל נְקָמ֣וֹת הוֹפִֽיַע׃
verses.en: O LORD, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

verses.he: הִ֭נָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵ֣ט הָאָ֑רֶץ הָשֵׁ֥ב גְּ֝מ֗וּל עַל־גֵּאִֽים׃
verses.en: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; Render to the proud their recompense.

verses.he: עַד־מָתַ֖י רְשָׁעִ֥ים׀ יְהוָ֑ה עַד־מָ֝תַ֗י רְשָׁעִ֥ים יַעֲלֹֽזוּ׃
verses.en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked exult?

verses.he: יַבִּ֣יעוּ יְדַבְּר֣וּ עָתָ֑ק יִֽ֝תְאַמְּר֗וּ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; All the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.

verses.he: עַמְּךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה יְדַכְּא֑וּ וְֽנַחֲלָתְךָ֥ יְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.en: They crush Thy people, O LORD, And afflict Thy heritage.

verses.he: אַ֭לְמָנָה וְגֵ֣ר יַהֲרֹ֑גוּ וִֽיתוֹמִ֣ים יְרַצֵּֽחוּ׃
verses.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.

verses.he: וַ֭יֹּ֣אמְרוּ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־יָּ֑הּ וְלֹא־יָ֝בִ֗ין אֱלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: And they say: 'The LORD will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob give heed.'

verses.he: בִּ֭ינוּ בֹּעֲרִ֣ים בָּעָ֑ם וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים מָתַ֥י תַּשְׂכִּֽילוּ׃
verses.en: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye understand?

verses.he: הֲנֹ֣טַֽע אֹ֖זֶן הֲלֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִֽם־יֹ֥צֵֽר עַ֝֗יִן הֲלֹ֣א יַבִּֽיט׃
verses.en: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?

verses.he: הֲיֹסֵ֣ר גּ֭וֹיִם הֲלֹ֣א יוֹכִ֑יחַ הַֽמְלַמֵּ֖ד אָדָ֣ם דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? Even He that teacheth man knowledge?

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה יֹ֭דֵעַ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָדָ֑ם כִּי־הֵ֥מָּה הָֽבֶל׃
verses.en: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

verses.he: אַשְׁרֵ֤י׀ הַגֶּ֣בֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶ֣נּוּ יָּ֑הּ וּֽמִתּוֹרָתְךָ֥ תְלַמְּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O LORD, And teachest out of Thy law;

verses.he: לְהַשְׁקִ֣יט ל֖וֹ מִ֣ימֵי רָ֑ע עַ֤ד יִכָּרֶ֖ה לָרָשָׁ֣ע שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.en: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.he: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־יִטֹּ֣שׁ יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְ֝נַחֲלָת֗וֹ לֹ֣א יַעֲזֹֽב׃
verses.en: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Neither will He forsake His inheritance.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עַד־צֶ֭דֶק יָשׁ֣וּב מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝אַחֲרָ֗יו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.en: For right shall return unto justice, And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.he: מִֽי־יָק֣וּם לִ֭י עִם־מְרֵעִ֑ים מִֽי־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב לִ֝י עִם־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.he: לוּלֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י כִּמְעַ֓ט׀ שָֽׁכְנָ֖ה דוּמָ֣ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

verses.he: אִם־אָ֭מַרְתִּי מָ֣טָה רַגְלִ֑י חַסְדְּךָ֥ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִסְעָדֵֽנִי׃
verses.en: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.

verses.he: בְּרֹ֣ב שַׂרְעַפַּ֣י בְּקִרְבִּ֑י תַּ֝נְחוּמֶ֗יךָ יְֽשַׁעַשְׁע֥וּ נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.en: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.

verses.he: הַֽ֭יְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּ֣א הַוּ֑וֹת יֹצֵ֖ר עָמָ֣ל עֲלֵי־חֹֽק׃
verses.en: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

verses.he: יָ֭גוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ צַדִּ֑יק וְדָ֖ם נָקִ֣י יַרְשִֽׁיעוּ׃
verses.en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.

verses.he: וַיְהִ֬י יְהוָ֣ה לִ֣י לְמִשְׂגָּ֑ב וֵ֝אלֹהַ֗י לְצ֣וּר מַחְסִֽי׃
verses.en: But the LORD hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

verses.he: וַיָּ֤שֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶ֨ם׀ אֶת־אוֹנָ֗ם וּבְרָעָתָ֥ם יַצְמִיתֵ֑ם יַ֝צְמִיתֵ֗ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own evil; The LORD our God will cut them off.
